**Result:** Record id 113 (PO-639182, vendor_id 132) successfully transitioned from **"received" → "closed"**.

**Summary of what I did:**
1. Queried `sourcing_purchase_orders` for po_number "PO-639182" — found two candidates sharing that PO number, distinguished by vendor_id. Only id 113 had vendor_id exactly `132` (the other, id 700, had vendor_id `"132-B"`, a different value, so it was excluded).
2. Retrieved both versions of the handling procedure document. Doc #15 is explicitly marked `[SUPERSEDED 2025]`; Doc #16 ("rev. 2") is explicitly marked `[CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions]`, so I applied the rev. 2 logic.
3. Per the current procedure: records verified in status "received" go to "closed" if `requested_by_employee_id` is "12", otherwise to "draft". Record 113 has `requested_by_employee_id = 12`, so it qualified for **closed**.
4. Applied exactly one transition (received → closed) to record id 113 only. No other fields or records were changed.
